## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the date a scholarly work was accepted by a journal, conference, or repository — the acceptance milestone in a review workflow; carried as DL-clean [xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with [`gmeow:dateSubmitted`](gmeow-dateSubmitted.md) (the submission milestone) or [`gmeow:datePublished`](gmeow-datePublished.md) (the issue date), and avoid [xsd:date.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date.)

### How to use

- Carry the acceptance instant on [`gmeow:dateAccepted`](gmeow-dateAccepted.md) as [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime), typically alongside [`gmeow:dateSubmitted`](gmeow-dateSubmitted.md) and [`gmeow:datePublished`](gmeow-datePublished.md) on a [`gmeow:Article`](../classes/gmeow-Article.md).

### Examples

- ex:paper [`gmeow:dateAccepted`](gmeow-dateAccepted.md) "2024-02-15T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
